author: World of Warcraft
description:
The Midnight MDI continued with defending champions Dignitas and runners up Liquid competing in Group C. On their path to victory, Dignitas put in an incredible 12 minute Magister's Terrace run setting the fastest we've seen and beating Liquid by just 6 seconds. Meeix breaks down their route.

► Full bracket & builds on Raider.IO: https://rio.gg/mdi_mdns1_groupc
► Watch the Finals VOD: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hrtVavk2BM8 
► Full MDI blog post here: https://blizz.ly/3P1qB2k

title: The Fastest Run of Midnight. Dignitas' Strategy Explained
